spec.image.defaultNote: Use the operator's --default-broker-image value when omitted.

spec.resources.requests.defaultNote: Use explicit limits if requests is omitted; otherwise Kubernetes selects an implementation-defined value.

spec.storage.defaultNote: Ephemeral emptyDir storage when omitted; create no PVC.

spec.storage.class.defaultNote: Use the cluster's default StorageClass when omitted.

spec.storage.deleteClaim.defaultNote: false for PersistentClaim or Jbod storage: retain PVCs when the StatefulSet is deleted.

spec.storage.volumes[].class.defaultNote: Use the cluster's default StorageClass when omitted.

spec.template.metadata.labels.defaultNote: {} when omitted; add no extra labels.

spec.template.metadata.annotations.defaultNote: {} when omitted; add no extra annotations.

spec.template.tolerations[].effect.defaultNote: Empty or omitted: match every taint effect.

spec.template.tolerations[].tolerationSe.defaultNote: Unset: tolerate a matching NoExecute taint indefinitely. Ignored for other effects.

spec.authorizationSecretRef.defaultNote: Derived from the krabka.io/cluster label: <cluster>-rebalancer-auth, key token.

spec.authorizationSecretRef.name.defaultNote: None for an explicit Secret reference.

spec.authorizationSecretRef.key.defaultNote: None for an explicit Secret reference.

spec.brokers.defaultNote: [] (no targeted brokers). Set broker IDs for removeBrokers or addBrokers.

spec.goals.defaultNote: Absent or empty: use the rebalancer's full default goal registry in priority order.

spec.throttleBytesPerSec.defaultNote: Use the rebalancer service's configured --default-throttle-bytes-per-sec value.

status.conditions[].message.example: Rebalance proposal is ready for approval.

spec.authentication.iterations.defaultNote: 8192 for SCRAM-SHA-512 or SCRAM-SHA-256. Applies only to SCRAM authentication.

spec.authentication.passwordLength.defaultNote: 32 raw bytes (44 base64 characters) for a generated SCRAM password. Existing password Secrets are retained.

spec.authentication.validityDays.defaultNote: 365 days for TLS client certificates. Applies only to type tls.

spec.authentication.renewalDays.defaultNote: 30 days before expiry for TLS certificate renewal. Applies only to type tls.

spec.authentication.maxLifetime.defaultNote: Use the broker's delegation_token_max_lifetime (documented default 7d); the broker also caps an explicit lifetime.

spec.authentication.renewBeforeExpiry.defaultNote: 24h for delegation-token authentication. The controller requires at least 60s.

spec.authorization.defaultNote: Absent: the operator skips ACL reconciliation.

spec.quotas.defaultNote: Absent: the operator does not manage quotas. {} removes all managed quota overrides.

spec.quotas.producerByteRate.defaultNote: Absent quotas: leave broker state unchanged. When quotas is present, omit this field to remove this quota override.

spec.quotas.consumerByteRate.defaultNote: Absent quotas: leave broker state unchanged. When quotas is present, omit this field to remove this quota override.

spec.quotas.requestPercentage.defaultNote: Absent quotas: leave broker state unchanged. When quotas is present, omit this field to remove this quota override.

spec.quotas.controllerMutationRate.defaultNote: Absent quotas: leave broker state unchanged. When quotas is present, omit this field to remove this quota override.
